name: What is the difference between fire cleanup and fire restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between fire cleanup and fire restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fire cleanup primarily focuses on removing debris, soot, and smoke residues to make a property habitable again. Fire restoration is a broader process that encompasses cleanup but also includes repairing, rebuilding, and restoring the property to its pre-loss condition. This may involve structural repairs, content restoration, and complete reconstruction, in addition to extensive cleaning and odor removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fire cleanup removes debris and residues. Fire restoration is a broader process that includes cleanup, repairs, rebuilding, and restoring the property to pre-loss condition.
